changes: Added enforcement of module requires_core declarations during loading, installation, and updates.
Enabled modules to register Admin API actions and moved Watch-folder functionality out of core.
Removed the Plex module from core to improve separation of optional integrations.
Moved per-file VOD importing into core through VodItemImporter.
Added bounded batch processing for Movies and Series imports.
Added core-managed TMDb genre mapping and improved vod_import_item payload processing.
Moved DVR recording management into core and improved recording-related stream handling.
Added a Telegram support bot that answers questions using project documentation, with a free cloud-model default.
Improved load-balancer installation and updates so nodes follow MAIN's release.
Improved installer preflight checks, xcvm_core prerequisite validation, SSH host-key handling, and file-transfer verification using SHA-256.
Improved RAM disk and sysctl configuration validation, including clearer errors and safer mount handling.
Fixed connection tracking when viewers reconnect through another node and reduced unnecessary waits during connection cleanup.
Fixed HLS viewer termination, RTMP admission checks, on-demand process cleanup, and native-remux stream previews.
Improved cluster API state reporting and load-balancer status tracking during updates and rollbacks.
Fixed HMAC identity handling in cluster reservations and restricted migration backup restoration to xc_vm_migrate.
Addressed Semgrep findings in import and recording code and improved process execution safety by removing shell-based commands in status and permission operations.
Fixed MAIN server IP auto-detection to skip loopback addresses.
Removed invalid voucher routes and fixed chart tooltips to use local time instead of UTC.
Standardized unit tests on MariaDB and the panel's own stack, updated the test guide and release checklist, and reduced output to PHPUnit's own results.
Configured static analysis on PHP 8.1, updated PHPStan dependencies, and improved end-to-end test synchronization.
Removed obsolete repository documentation and metadata files and updated agent documentation to match the code.
